title: Birth date in 1907 and a photograph of the Donaldsonville church
summary: He gives his birth date as January 31, 1907, his baptism in a church shared by both races, and identifies the church in a picture.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Just to check the dates on the thing now, when were you born?

I was born in 1907, January the 31st. And I was Christian there at the colored, I mean they didn't have any colored Catholic church in Downsville there, but I can't think of the name of the church, but it was a big Catholic church they had. And at that time the colored and white went to the same church, you know, what's the color that's in the back view, you know. Does this look like it?
Do you remember it says interior? Oh yeah, that's the church.

Yeah, that's the big church. It was about two blocks from the river. Yeah, that's it. That was a big, in other words, it looked just like this church on Tulane, that big Catholic church on Tulane, right past the child's hospital.
Oh yeah, yeah. I was looking at it, I was trying to wonder what this high steeple was. Yeah, this is the steeple of it, yeah.
You need a glass there, a magnifying glass.

And this facing this way is what you call facing the river, this way. Mm-hmm. Yeah. I can't think of the... You were born in Downsville in New Orleans? Yeah. No, I was born in Downsville. I should explain the reason for that.
I can see it without the glass. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Old and New Catholic Church, it says. You need to broke the glass. What is it again? I can't see it. Old and New Catholic Church.

Well, that's... They have a colored Catholic Church there now. Mm-hmm. I mean, well, it's been out since about around 30, I think. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Now, we'll see. I didn't get back to tell you, but I was...
